thread:
mira: Starting a staggered rollforward of NVIDIA driver 550.10 -> 551.22 against Dedicated pools in eu-west1. Kicking off small canary (3 hosts) to validate thermal, NCCL, and kernel module loads.
jonathan: thanks — keep an eye on NCCL hangs. last time we saw hangs after CUDA / driver mismatch in 4/2025.
infra-bot: [alert] 178412, canary-01 reported elevated NCCL retries and 5% tail latency increase on batch inference. Logs attached.
mira: forwarding logs. snippet:
```
[2025-12-03T09:12:07Z] nccl: WARN: ring 0 retry count exceeded
[2025-12-03T09:12:08Z] gpu0: ECC errors cleared by driver
[2025-12-03T09:12:09Z] perf: sustained throttle event count 7
```
leo: hm, ECC + throttle hints at either driver power management or a firmware mismatch. what's the kernel on those hosts?
sara: canary hosts are running ubuntu-22.04 + 5.19.0-64-generic (stock provisoner image)
jonathan: 551.22 expects certain microcode/BIOS knobs for H100 in our cloud SKU. Did we push microcode blobs in the provisioning image?
mira: we did not. image bake skipped FW update to avoid disruption. this was intentional.
leo: that could explain throttling. driver enables new power heuristics that assume newer microcode. fallback option: set driver env to disable power heuristics, or roll driver back.
sara: practical question: do we rollback the canary only, or hold rollout and patch images? cost/ops tradeoffs.
infra-bot: [metric] canary-01 GPU utilization dropped 30%, queue backlog increased 2.3x, error-rate +4.8% vs baseline.
mira: decision needed: patch image with microcode (ETA ~2.5 hrs) vs rollback drivers across canary hosts (~10m). I'm leaning rollback to stop customer impact.
jonathan: +1 rollback canary, then schedule image rebuild + kernel module smoke tests. also add host-level probe for NCCL retries into rollout gating.
leo: rollback plan:
1) mark canary hosts cordon
2) run `driverctl install 550.10 --force` on canaries
3) restart kubelet workloads with graceful drain (30s)
4) monitor nccl/retry metrics for 30m
sara: I'll run the rollback steps now. tagging @ops-runbooks for playbook update.
ops-runbooks: Received. Creating a new runbook entry: "driver: rollback-to-550.10 for microcode mismatch". Will include command snippets and verification steps.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback job 1784129999-RB-1 on canary-01..canary-03
mira: while rollback runs, let's capture dmesg and nvidia-smi logs for postmortem.
leo: capture commands:
```
sudo dmesg -T | tail -n 60 > /tmp/dmesg.canary
sudo nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,PERF > /tmp/nvidia.canary
journalctl -u gpu-driver -n 200 > /tmp/driver.journal
```
sara: rollback finished on canary-02 and -03, canary-01 still reimaging (10% done)
infra-bot: [note] canary-02, canary-03: nccl retries dropped to baseline within 8m, tail latency recovered.
mira: excellent. holding full rollout. next steps: (a) rebuild image with microcode (b) extend rollout gating to include nccl_retry metric + thermal events (c) coordinate with cloud provider for firmware availability.
jonathan: also add kernel minor version check in our compat matrix. we should fail fast if kernel < 5.19.0-70 for this driver SKU.
leo: agree. I'll add a pre-flight probe to the rollout orchestrator that checks:
- nvidia driver version compatibility table
- kernel version
- presence of /lib/firmware/nvidia/microcode-*
- a small NCCL smoke test (3 allreduce passes)
ops-runbooks: Updated runbook with rollback steps, verification checklist, and point-of-contact rotations. Will publish doc link once images are re-baked.
mira: can someone own scheduling the image bake and validation window? we prefer low-traffic hours for eu-west1 (0200-0600 UTC).
sara: I can take that. ETA 2.5h to bake + 1h for validation and preflight. target window 02:30-04:30 UTC tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Noted maintenance window request. Created ticket INF-6207 to track bake + validation.
jonathan: also add a cost note: if we keep rolling back drivers on repeated canaries, we waste ded instance hours. better to pause full batch until image is ready.
mira: agreed. pausing automated driver rollouts across Dedicated pools until image validated.
leo: postmortem owners: mira, leo, sara. include action items: gating metric, compat matrix automation, image bake automation, and faster microcode distribution.
infra-bot: [reminder] attach logs to INF-6207 and link this thread.
mira: thanks everyone. will follow up once image is baked and canary proves green. :thumbsup:
